description: Probabilistic forecast of the target series at the requested quantile levels, in the input's units.

quantile_levels.description: The quantile levels of each quantiles row, ascending: the requested ones, or the 21 trained levels.

median.description: The 0.5 quantile for each future step (interpolated when 0.5 was not requested).

quantiles.description: One row per future step, one value per quantile level.

past_covariate_forecasts.description: Present when past_covariates were given: one forecast per past covariate, in their order.
